title: Neil deGrasse Tyson EDUCATES MAGA Id*ot Ben Shapiro on Transgender
description:
Neil deGrasse Tyson sat down with Ben Shapiro for a long-form conversation about science, culture, and the limits of what data can actually settle, and what unfolded became one of the most widely discussed exchanges either of them has ever had on the subject of gender, biology, and free inquiry. This clip captures the heart of that conversation, along with full breakdown commentary explaining why the debate went the direction it did.

The setup is straightforward. Ben Shapiro, host of The Ben Shapiro Show and one of the most recognizable conservative commentators in American media, opens by arguing that progressive politics has drifted away from scientific reality, using the transgender debate and the question of transgender athletes in women's sports as his central example. His position is that biological sex in mammals is binary, that sex and gender cannot be fully separated, and that teaching children about a gender spectrum introduces theory into a science classroom where it does not belong.

Neil deGrasse Tyson, astrophysicist, director of the Hayden Planetarium at the American Museum of Natural History, and host of StarTalk, does not accept that framing. Rather than debating whether sex is binary, he reframes the entire question around consequences. He points out that the sports question only carries weight because athletics are currently segregated by gender, and he raises the possibility that future competition could be organized around measurable hormonal profiles ra
